_comment: Preconfigured instances of the vision-card element. provider:'maplibre' flags the generated standalone page as TOKEN-FREE (see internal/generate-tree.mjs) so it mounts the element INSTANTLY with no Mapbox token ladder — correct for a self-contained single element that uses no map at all. The card's numbers are computed from data (see HOW-THE-NUMBERS-ARE-COUNTED.md); an instance may set title, tagline, accent or locale, never numbers.
